title: S01T04 - Add work queue and sprint board view models to packages/ui-model
description: Extend the shared view layer beyond WorkItemView for ready queues, blocked queues, active blockers, reservations, evidence counts, and lane state.
acceptanceCriteria: Types cover global queues and per-sprint board lanes without parsing human CLI output.
Unit tests cover active blocker and reservation summary derivation.
closedReason: Work queue and sprint board view models are implemented and covered by TypeScript plus focused ui-model tests.
